title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
summary: How tiny, compounding improvements and well-designed systems build lasting habits. Covers identity-based change and the four laws of behaviour change.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
summary: Why distraction-free concentration is rare and valuable, and how to structure your life to do more of it.

title: Slow Productivity
author: Cal Newport
summary: A sustainable alternative to busyness: do fewer things, work at a natural pace, and obsess over quality.
